key_insight: Cura 1T is a healthcare-specialized LLM designed to jointly support patient communication, clinical reasoning, multimodal understanding, diagnosis, and EHR tool use.
clinical_relevance: The model aims to improve real-world healthcare workflows by handling multiple high-stakes tasks without sacrificing performance across them.
method: Agent plans a target capability, trains, and reviews benchmark failures
Data mixture is refined using targeted synthetic and curated examples
evidence_signal: Across a healthcare evaluation suite, Cura 1T ranks at or near the top versus frontier baselines while staying competitive on out-of-domain reasoning and agentic benchmarks.
watch_item: Results are promising, but deployment would still need careful validation because performance can vary by task and healthcare settings are high risk.
paper_title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
